subject: Onboarding needs for the playbook profile (replaces my triad ask)
body: Ignore my earlier triad/leverage ask. Onboarding will fill, per state (1 to 3, MVP 1): label, words, memoryCue (short private cue), strategy.steps[] {modality V|A|K|other, direction external|internal, content in their words, submodalities}, fullyInAt (step index), anchorStep, contrast {label, submodalities}, differences[] {modality, attribute, peak, contrast, ratingDelta}, drivers[] (refs to differences), recode {appliedDrivers}, test {before, after}, futurePace {situation}, calibration {peak, contrast} (sensing summaries with quality), confirmedAt. Please give me a controlled vocabulary for the core submodality keys and values (picture: location, size, distance, brightness, associated; sound: source, volume, direction; feeling: bodyLocation, intensity, moving), or the differences can't be computed. Also a Stopped result for run(). Is the derived triad helper yours (contracts/) or mine?
